scene.line: My name is Iridessa. I'm a light-talent.
But when mystery calls, I become Bright Eyes, Fairy Detective!
Bright Eyes, my sparkles are missing!
I flew into Dulcie's Kitchen for a cookie.
And I left my bag of sparkles outside.
When I came back out, the bag was gone!
Was it windy? Maybe the bag blew away.
There was no wind. Blaze the Firefly was there - he'll tell you.
I'd better talk to Dulcie.
Sorry, Bright Eyes. I haven't seen Fira's sparkles.
You use sparkles to light your oven fires, right?
Yes. I get them from the Minister of Autumn.
He likes my Acorn Cookies!
Maybe he took the sparkles with him.
I'll find out. Thanks, Dulcie.
I didn't visit Dulcie today, Bright Eyes.
But I do give her sparkles for her oven.
She makes the best Acorn Cookies!
Who else might want sparkles, Minister?
Well, fireflies love them.
They try to sneak them all the time.
Ah-HA!
Blaze the Firefly was there when her sparkles disappeared!
I need to talk to Blaze!
Bzzz!
Bzzz bzzz!
Where did you get the sparkles, Blaze?
Bzzz!
Outside of Dulcie's Kitchen?
Bzzz. Bzzz.
Blaze, those sparkles belong to Fira.
Bzzz?
Don't worry, I'll make you some sparkles myself.
Bzzz bzzz!
Another mystery solved!
